verse.verse_2: and by the night when it covers the world with peace:
verse.verse_3: (O Prophet), your Lord has neither forsaken you, nor is He displeased.
verse.verse_4: Indeed what is to come will be better for you than what has gone by.
verse.verse_5: Verily your Lord will soon give you so amply that you will be well-pleased.
verse.verse_6: Did He not find you an orphan and then gave you shelter?
verse.verse_7: Did He not find you unaware of the Right Way, and then directed you to it?
verse.verse_8: And did He not find you in want, and then enriched you?
verse.verse_9: Therefore, be not harsh with the orphan;
verse.verse_10: and chide not him who asks,
verse.verse_11: and proclaim the bounty of your Lord.
